chunks: And with this chain of narration, it was said: A man complained to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) that the road had been cut off from him (i.e., he was prevented from traveling or his path was obstructed).
So he said to him: Why do you not wear a ring of Aqiq (cornelian)? For indeed, it protects one from all evil.

And in another hadith, Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Whoever wears a ring of Aqiq, he will continually see the good outcome (al-husna) as long as it is in his hand, and protection (waqiyyah) from Allah, the Exalted and Mighty, will remain upon him.

key_terms.الْعَقِیق: Aqiq (a specific type of cornelian stone)

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual benefits of wearing an Aqiq ring according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Thawab al-A'mal*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) prescribes the Aqiq ring as a spiritual remedy for removing obstacles, emphasizing its role in safeguarding against all forms of evil. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) further elaborates on its eschatological benefit, promising that the wearer will continuously behold 'al-Husna' (the best outcome) and remain under divine protection as long as the ring is in their possession. This tradition underscores the Shia belief in the tangible spiritual efficacy of specific adornments when worn with intention.
